column4: description
Write a release checklist for a library before tagging a version. Use when preparing a release of a package.
Generate RFC 5545 iCalendar (.ics) files for meetings and reminders. Use when asked to create a calendar invite, an event file, or an .ics attachment from a date, time, and title.
Set up a consistent local development environment for new contributors. Use when onboarding a developer onto a repository.

Conducts multi-axis code review. Use before merging any change. Use when reviewing code written by yourself, another agent, or a human. Use when you need to assess code quality across multiple dimensions before it enters the main branch. Use when asked to review a diff or a pull request, even when the diff is pasted inline.

Enter the away posture when the captain invokes /afk, says they are going afk, `state/.afk-contract` or `state/.afk` exists, an incoming message starts with `FM_INJECT_MARK`, or any `state/.subsuper-*` marker is involved. Load it at once in the /afk turn, before any other work, and on the first unmarked message while away to render the return brief.
Load only when auditing or maintaining the complete agent-only skill trigger index.

Recap visible session events and guide the captain through visibly unanswered decisions when the captain explicitly invokes /ahoy, with a Bearings fallback when /ahoy is the session's first real captain message.
Single owner of ask-user finding policy. Load before deciding any ask-user finding.
Load whenever /afk or /quiet is invoked, an away or quiet record exists, or a marked away-supervisor message arrives.

Generate a "pick up where I left off" fleet digest. Use when the captain invokes /bearings (plain, file, or lavish) or asks for a bearings report, morning brief, status report, catch-up, "where did I leave off", or "what's in the works". Also use on a contributions check wake, when filing work linked to an upstream issue, and on a procevent lavish wake whose source id is the bearings board's.

Load when the session-start digest's bootstrap or network-checks section, or a standalone bin/fm-bootstrap.sh or bin/fm-startup-network.sh run, prints an actionable diagnostic line - MISSING, MISSING_MANUAL, OUTDATED, PRESENTATION_UNAVAILABLE, BACKEND_INVALID, NEEDS_GH_AUTH, TANGLE, STARTUP_MEMORY_BUDGET, CREW_DISPATCH invalid, FLEET_SYNC, NETWORK_CHECKS, HOME_SUMMARY, BACKLOG_RECONCILE, SECONDMATE_SYNC, SECONDMATE_LIVENESS, SECONDMATE_HANDOFF, NUDGE_SECONDMATES, or FMX - or reports that an interrupted backlog cleanup may have left an endpoint or local copy. A silent bootstrap section, or any other BOOTSTRAP_INFO fact, means no skill load.

Load before treating an investigation, scout report, structured review, or Lavish review as complete, before ending a visual review that exposed a captain decision, when recording or routing the captain's answer, and on any RECORD DIVERGENCE line the wake drain prints.
Load before scoping a reported bug and before acting on a diagnostic report.
Load before creating, reading, steering, archiving, debugging, or reviewing a Codex App visible thread for Firstmate work, and before responding to requests to make Codex App native to Firstmate.
Load before editing firstmate's shared, tracked material as defined by AGENTS.md section 1, whether working as firstmate directly or as a crewmate briefed on a firstmate-repo task.
Load when switching to Orca, spawning or supervising Orca-backed work, smoke-testing Orca backend behavior, debugging Orca task state, or reconciling Orca-backed task metadata.

Load before dispatching, promoting, relaunching, or delivering any task whose project is the firstmate repository itself, when a firstmate bug or improvement idea surfaces in ordinary use, before granting or revoking upstream publication authority, and before deciding whether any push, pull request, issue, comment, or fork may reach firstmate's own upstream.

Relay playbook, loaded only when Relay is enabled. Load on an "x-mention <request_id>", "x-mode-error ...", or "public-followup ..." check wake, on milestone and terminal wakes for a Relay-linked task before posting completion follow-ups, and whenever a promised final public reply must be created, reconciled, or delivered.

Load before spawning or recovering a crewmate or secondmate, handling a trust dialog, sending a harness-specific skill invocation, interrupting or exiting an agent, resuming an exited agent, or verifying a new harness adapter.
Load when locating, interpreting, or changing Firstmate home, config, data, state, project, or generated runtime paths.

Load before arming a long-polling source firstmate owns, before registering a deterministic condition->action watch, on any `procevent <adapter> <source-id> <sequence>` check wake, and on any `process-event source stranded` or `process-event source failed to start` check wake.
Load before adding, creating, removing, or initializing a project. Cloning or registering a project is add intake and uses the same trigger.

Enter quiet supervision mode when the captain invokes /quiet or asks for quiet mode, quiet-while-present, or fewer routine wake turns while they stay in the session. Unlike /afk, ordinary captain chat does not exit it; only an explicit `/quiet off` does.
Load when a crew-dispatch rule or default resolves to more than one profile candidate.
Load when a scout reports completion, presents a visual artifact for iteration, or is being considered for promotion to implementation.
Load when creating, seeding, validating, launching, recovering, handing backlog to, pushing inherited local material into, or retiring a secondmate home, or when editing data/secondmates.md.
Load when the session-start digest reports unfinished checks, actionable diagnostics, recovery inputs, or output requiring interpretation.
Load when a ship reports a PR or ready branch, when deciding or monitoring landing, and before task cleanup.

Evaluate one or more external agent skills - a URL, GitHub repo or path, skills.sh entry, or local folder - for adoption into firstmate or its workers. Load before fetching, reading, comparing, trialling, or recommending any third-party skill, when the captain asks whether a skill is worth installing, replacing an existing skill with, or borrowing from, and before any skill from outside this repository is placed in a skill folder. Not for writing a new skill from scratch or for reviewing firstmate's own skills.

Sweep the session for uncaptured durable knowledge and unfiled or wrong open work records, and curate startup memory. Use when the captain invokes /stow (e.g. "/stow", "stow what you've learned"), before a session reset or context compaction, or periodically to keep operational memory current.

Load when the session-start digest reports an ordinary direct report's endpoint dead or its metadata has no window, after a stale wake, looping pane, repeated confusion, an answered-by-brief question, an unresponsive crewmate, or a failed steer, after observing a defeated Claude or Codex bypass, and when a live crewmate reports its no-mistakes pipeline dead, unreachable, or timed out.

Self-update a running firstmate and its secondmates to the latest from origin. Use when the captain invokes /updatefirstmate (e.g. "/updatefirstmate", "update firstmate", "pull the latest firstmate").
Load when a ship starts or already has an active no-mistakes validation run, including a mid-run requirement change or finding, and before deciding or answering any ask-user finding.
